intentions.title: Give every Barkpark Paper a premium per-block WYSIWYG editor whose in-canvas edits are byte-identical to the reader's PortableDoc render
intentions.evidence: index.js docblock: 'premium per-block rich-text editor (Barkpark papers)'; convert.js maps every portable-doc block/inline shape 1:1 to TipTap JSON against api/lib/barkpark/portable_doc/render.ex and patch.ex; __smoke.mjs (18) is the round-trip harness asserting load-identity + edit-fold fixpoints across 1000+1000 property fuzz iterations (smoke/projection-fuzz.mjs, smoke/round-trip.mjs).

intentions.title: LiveView remains the single source of truth for the block list — each block gets its own isolated TipTap instance that emits a DocPatchOp, never a giant shared ProseMirror document
intentions.evidence: index.js: 'LiveView owns the block list; EACH rich-text block is edited by its OWN TipTap-vanilla instance... does NOT build one giant ProseMirror document'; on edit it emits patch-block via bubbling CustomEvent('bp-op') (buildPatchBlockOp in convert.js).

intentions.title: Notion-style '/' slash menu keeps every insertable block type (text, article-chrome, visual, field, structured) in lockstep with the server's default_block/2 and the Studio add-block dropdown, so the two entrypoints never diverge
intentions.evidence: slash-menu.js: SLASH_ITEMS is a curated ~30-item catalog (paragraph, heading, callout, diagram, field-string, composite, codelist...) explicitly documented as 'mirrors the add-block dropdown in studio_live.ex verbatim... resolves to a default_block/2 clause on the server'; EX2 expectation-aware top group reads server-rendered [data-expected-fields] JSON.

intentions.title: Enable inline `[[wikilink]]` and `#tag` autocomplete against live document/tag search without coupling the trigger-detection logic to the DOM or TipTap
intentions.evidence: wikilink-trigger.js is explicitly DOM-free ('no document, no TipTap, no HTMLElement') so parseOpenWikilink/parseOpenTag are unit-testable in plain Node (__wikilink.test.mjs, importance 9); wikilink-menu.js + index.js wire the browser half with async candidate sources (wikilinkSource/tagSource) and stale-response guarding via monotonic _wlSeq/_tagSeq.

intentions.title: Template-locked structural blocks (forced title heading, featured image) can never be deleted or reordered out of a Paper, in both directions of the edit pipeline
intentions.evidence: __locked.test.mjs (pdd-t2): asserts locked/role survive blocks<->nodes round-trip, runToOps in canvas/run-convert.js never emits remove-block/move-block for a locked id, and transactionVetoesLock (canvas/locks.js) rejects any tx deleting/moving a locked node — 'belt-and-braces over the server backstop + the live filterTransaction veto'.

intentions.title: Server-painted read-only 'fleet' components (task board, cards, pipeline, roadmap, forms, questionnaires, asciicast) ride inside the paper canvas as verbatim, structurally-only atoms — never decomposed into editable content ops
intentions.evidence: __fleet.test.mjs (pdd-t8, importance 14): FLEET_FIXTURES enumerates 12 fleet types kept in lockstep with run-convert.js CANVAS_FLEET_TYPES + shared/paper.ex @fleet_render_types + render/components.ex/figures.ex/forms.ex emitters; 'the WHOLE block rides VERBATIM on bpBlock, ZERO value/content ops'.

intentions.title: Every non-editable canvas atom (sheet embed, generic embed, fleet block) is fully keyboard-reachable and screen-reader announceable — no mouse-only interaction
intentions.evidence: __one_surface.test.mjs (pdd-t12c): tests isBlockLocked, atomAriaLabel, isActivateKey, sheetChipLabel/embedChipLabel/fleetChipLabel from canvas/embed-node.js as the pure half of tabindex/role/aria wiring and the Enter/Space -> NodeSelection bridge.

intentions.title: Featured-image and other picker fields show a consistent empty-state placeholder (copy + activation model) until an asset is chosen, then commit the picked value through the same patch-op identity path
intentions.evidence: __featured_placeholder.test.mjs (t13, pd-doctrine rule 1+5): tests isEmptyPickerValue, imagePlaceholderModel, coercePickerValue, IMAGE_PLACEHOLDER_LABEL/HINT from canvas/field-node.js, decoupled from the browser-only ghost-frame reveal-on-activate node-view.
